en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with a white house in the foreground, surrounded by fields and a wooded hill. There is a dirt path leading to the house, and a person or figure can be seen in the field. The overall tone of the image is sepia or black and white, indicating an old photograph. At the bottom, there is Dutch text, and on the left margin, there is a publisher's credit.
